title: Canonical Profile Schema
description: Internal source-of-truth schema for resume content, website content, and export configuration.

$schema.description: Relative path to the canonical schema file.

meta.description: Document-level metadata for the canonical profile.

canonical.description: Canonical public URL for the generated JSON Resume asset.

version.description: Semantic version of the canonical profile document.

lastModified.description: Last modification date for the canonical profile.

basics.description: Primary identity, contact, and summary information for the profile owner.

name.description: Full name used across resume, website, and PDFs.

shortName.description: Short display name used in compact UI contexts.

image.description: Canonical public image URL for the profile.

summary.description: Main professional summary used as the source biography.

location.description: Structured location information for the profile owner.

profiles.description: Structured social profiles used across website and exports.

network.description: Profile network name, such as LinkedIn or GitHub.

url.description: Canonical URL for the social profile.

connections.description: Additional contact connections that do not fit the standard social-profile model.

url.description: Connection target URL, including mailto links where needed.

location.description: Human-readable location string for the role.

description.description: Optional short descriptor of the employer or context.

summary.description: Core summary of the volunteer role.

skills.description: Grouped skill areas and their associated keywords.

languages.description: Languages spoken by the profile owner.

projects.description: Project and case-study entries used across resume and website.

presentation.description: Website-facing presentation metadata for the project.

slug.description: Slug used for the project page and lookup.

listing.description: Metadata for project listing placement and card treatment.

featured.description: Whether the project appears in featured project collections.

order.description: Sort order used in project listings.

label.description: Optional short label used above the project title in listing cards.

cover.description: Visual metadata for the project cover swatch.

tone.description: Named color tone token used by the website.

meta.description: Project metadata shown on project pages.

focus.description: Short focus statement for the project.

seo.description: SEO metadata for the project page.

website.description: Website-specific content, navigation, and page copy.

baseUrl.description: Canonical base URL for the website.

pages.description: Content blocks for each top-level website page.

graphicLabels.description: Text labels embedded in the decorative homepage graphic.

aside.description: Supporting aside card on the homepage hero row.

featuredCollection.description: Intro block for featured project listings.

linkLabel.description: Label for the link to all work.

narrative.description: Primary narrative block on the homepage.

focusList.description: Current focus list shown on the homepage.

principlesEyebrow.description: Eyebrow for the adjacent principles list.

featureCards.description: Feature card grid on the about page.

socialLinkDescription.description: Description shown in social contact cards.

emailLinkLabel.description: Label for the email contact card.

emailLinkDescription.description: Description shown in the email contact card.

work.description: Simple hero content model for the work index page.

contact.description: Labels and download metadata for the resume page.

labels.description: Contact field labels shown on the resume page.

downloadLabel.description: Button label for the resume download menu.

downloads.description: Labels for generated downloadable resume assets.

resumePdf.description: Label for the resume PDF download.

cvPdf.description: Label for the CV PDF download.

jsonResume.description: Label for the JSON Resume download.

sections.description: Section labels and headings for the resume page.

presentLabel.description: Label used for open-ended date ranges.

supporting.description: Supporting sidebar labels for the resume page.

roleLabel.description: Label for the role meta field.

timelineLabel.description: Label for the timeline meta field.

toolsLabel.description: Label for the tools meta field.

focusLabel.description: Label for the focus meta field.

callToAction.description: Closing CTA block for project pages.

exports.description: Export-specific configuration for generated resume artifacts.

language.description: Language name passed through to RenderCV.

settings.description: Shared RenderCV settings for all variants.

currentDate.description: Current date behavior for rendered PDFs.

output.description: Output path template for the generated PDF.

summary.description: Description of the variant's intended usage.

datePartial.description: Date string accepting YYYY, YYYY-MM, or YYYY-MM-DD.

stringList.description: List of strings used for repeated keyword-style content.

iconDefinition.description: Reusable icon descriptor supporting custom site icons and Font Awesome icons.

kind.description: Marks this icon as a custom site icon.
Marks this icon as a Font Awesome icon.

name.description: Font Awesome icon name without the fa- prefix.

websiteAction.description: Reusable website action object pointing at either a URL or a generated asset.

asset.description: Generated asset identifier resolved at build time.

websitePageSeo.description: Reusable SEO metadata block for a website page.
